notes: Verified S-tier DMV catch-up: Chucho Valdés marks his 85th birthday at Strathmore with special guests Joe Lovano and Etienne Charles in a retrospective centered on his Afro-Cuban jazz legacy.

events.subtitle: 85th Birthday Celebration with special guests Joe Lovano and Etienne Charles
events.factual_description: Strathmore presents Chucho Valdés on Sunday, October 18, 2026 at 7:30 PM in The Music Center at Strathmore for an 85th Birthday Celebration with special guests Joe Lovano and Etienne Charles. The official presentation frames the concert as a retrospective across a career that shaped Afro-Cuban jazz, from Irakere's fusion of Afro-Cuban ritual music, jazz, rock and classical elements through Valdés's recent work.

en.why_it_matters: At 85, Valdés is not being presented as a museum piece: the program explicitly looks back across the language he helped build, while Joe Lovano and Etienne Charles add two sharply different improvisational voices. In the DMV, this is a rare chance to hear one of Afro-Cuban jazz's foundational living architects in a celebratory but still open-ended setting.
en.trip_verdict: Protect the evening. This is S-tier locally and strong enough to justify a regional trip to the DMV for a listener following living masters, Afro-Cuban jazz and distinctive instrumental voices.

es.why_it_matters: A los 85 años, Valdés no aparece como pieza de museo: el programa mira hacia el lenguaje que él ayudó a construir, mientras Joe Lovano y Etienne Charles aportan dos voces improvisatorias muy distintas. En el DMV, es una oportunidad rara de escuchar a uno de los arquitectos vivos fundamentales del jazz afrocubano en un contexto celebratorio pero todavía abierto musicalmente.
es.trip_verdict: Hay que proteger la noche. Es S en el ámbito local y suficientemente fuerte para justificar un viaje regional al DMV si el eje son los maestros vivos, el jazz afrocubano y las voces instrumentales con identidad propia.
